headline: Vote on a purchase power agreement for the Wood Pyrolysis Demonstration Project, plus electric rate tariff changes.
summary: A presentation on the wood pyrolysis project is expected to be followed by an executive session. Other items include September financials, a 2027 property and boiler insurance renewal, and energy services updates.
items: Large general (LG), large general time of use (LT), and primary service (PS) tariff amendments
Home electric vehicle (EV) charging tariff amendments
Commercial and industrial thermal flex load management (Building GIANTS) permanent tariff
Wood pyrolysis demonstration project presentation, followed by expected executive session
Wood pyrolysis demonstration project purchase power agreement vote
BED 2027 property and boiler and machinery insurance renewal vote
location: Burlington Electric Department, 585 Pine Street, Burlington, Vermont 05401, and via Microsoft Teams
